protocol.visibilityInput: The junction receives the exact cells hidden by a synthetic rectangle. The mask is supplied locally and is not inferred or transmitted as a wave.
protocol.scoring: Ordinary overlap divides matched cells by all reference cells. Visibility-aware overlap divides by visible reference cells and requires at least 60% to remain visible. Equal winning poses cause abstention.
protocol.coverageControl: The same junction also scores visible overlap without the minimum-visibility gate as a read-only diagnostic.
protocol.physicalControl: Both scores use the same returning waveform C. Only the visibility-aware result is emitted on the carrier. The disconnected reference still circulates but is gated at the comparator input.
protocol.scope: Synthetic fixed-scale, top-down silhouettes only. The experiment does not test unknown occluders or photographic segmentation.
